title: 云依助手 0.13.1
releaseNotes: Redesigns Software Uninstaller with a scrolling app list, fixed details, five-item pagination and an explicit cleanup confirmation. Adds bounded, cancellable background discovery of nested Start Menu and desktop shortcuts by their actual targets, post-uninstall residual revalidation and shared-folder protection. Unselected items remain available after partial cleanup. Desktop sidebar icons now use a consistent outline SVG style. All 20 built-in tools and the packaged pink Yiyi character are retained.
